text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aight~ Time to do some super-glam, 
mega-cute birthday nails for Journey-san☆ 
Gotta put my soul into this~!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Journey doing her nails...? What brought 
this on?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Jordan-san told me she'd do my nails as a 
birthday gift. Fufu, what a delightful 
present.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Nah, but it's surprising. Journey-san's so 
serious, I thought there was a good chance 
she'd turn me down.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't possibly turn down such 
kindness. Besides... I thought this would 
be a wonderful opportunity to learn so 
much from you, including nail care.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You're kidding, right~? All I'm really 
good at is doing nails and gossiping~.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Not at all. Casual 'conversations' like 
that always feel fresh and fascinating to 
me. Yes, very much so—"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
? Wait, Nakayama, did you get her a 
birthday present too~? Aren't we all 
buddies who are always getting helped out 
by Journey-san~?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha... Of course I have it ready. 
Along with a special 'story'—as a set.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I'm delighted by this. I look forward to 
hearing what you have to say—very much so.
